relations.evidence: The Index Service supports the creation of primary and secondary indexes on items stored within the Data Service.

relations.subject: index:memory-optimized-storage
relations.evidence: Only available in Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition. Indexes are saved in-memory.

relations.subject: index:standard-storage
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server Community Edition, writes can either be _append-only_ or _write with circular reuse_, depending on the write mode selected for global secondary indexes. Each index gets a dedicated file.

relations.subject: index:standard-storage
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition, compaction is handled automatically.

relations.subject: index:standard-storage
relations.evidence: As of Couchbase Server 7.0, multiple indexes are stored in a given file.
